en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.998 - It has been narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:

"A person does not forget the Takbira al-Ihram (the opening Takbir)."
[REFERENCES]
Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 343 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 915 • Ithbāt al-Hudāt, Part 4, p. 148
